package.name: dual_arm_pose_optimization
package.description:
C4.2: handover / standby pose and cooperative-zone optimization for the S622 dual-arm system.
S1 scope (this package's first slice): build a MoveIt PlanningScene OFFLINE (no ROS node) from URDF + SRDF, using the real STL collision meshes and FCL, with hard assertions that every mesh actually loaded. Provides the three collision-distance readings the plan requires (whole-robot minimum vs cross-arm minimum vs C2.7 capsule proxy), the SRDF / cross-arm / robot-world allowed-collision matrices, and a floor object with an explicit base_link exemption.
